from_offset.description: shell: byte offset in the log; the reply gives next_offset.

include_finished.description: List only. Default true, finished runs retained for the session.

scope.description: No id only. Default children. all includes siblings and ancestors.

mode.description: steer (default): next step of a running recipient, wakes an idle one. followup: after the recipient's current turn ends, as its own turn. quiet: delivered at the recipient's next model request, never wakes.

command.description: shell only. Command line run with the user's shell.

context.description: agent only. fork seeds the run with your completed turns, excluding the turn in flight (default fresh).

description.description: 3-8 word label for display and for default naming.

model_tier.description: agent only. Clamped to your tier.

name.description: Optional unique name others can address this run by. `main` and `parent` are reserved.

notify.description: On finish: wake starts a turn if you are idle (default), quiet waits for your next turn, never sends nothing (read with runs).

one_shot.description: agent only. Complete after the first result instead of staying available. Default false.

output_schema.description: agent only. JSON Schema the final result must satisfy.

prompt.description: agent only. The complete, self-contained task.

subagent_type.description: agent only. research is read-only; general can edit. Default general.

timeout_secs.description: Wall clock limit. Default: 1800 for agents, 3600 for shell. 0 asks for the session maximum, so a long task is not cut off at the default. Expiry ends the run as timed_out.

watch.description: shell only. Regex (Rust syntax) matched against each stdout/stderr line; matches become notices, at most 1 per second (lines in between are batched) and 20 per minute, then one overflow notice. Wakes you only with notify=wake. A bad regex is rejected.

reason.description: Forwarded to the run as its last message.

soft.description: Agents only. Cancel the current turn, stay idle, keep the inbox.
